title: The Gold That Is Nairobi's Sewage
standfirst: A visit to Apeldoorn changed how I see urban wastewater. For Kenyan and African cities, the opportunity is cleaner rivers, useful energy, recovered nutrients and water safely reused.
seo_title: The Gold That Is Nairobi's Sewage | Waithaka Ndegwa
seo_description: Lessons from an Apeldoorn sewage plant for Nairobi and African cities: biogas, nutrient recovery, safe water reuse and accountable sanitation.
featured_image_alt: Illustrative composite of wastewater treatment, resource recovery and a Nairobi skyline.
featured_image_caption: AI-generated editorial composite inspired by my Apeldoorn visit; not a photograph of an existing Nairobi plant or evidence that treated water is safe to drink.
